patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts frequently pair large, engaging imagery or graphic elements with text blocks, often with a strong left or right alignment.
Consistent use of bold, uppercase sans-serif typography for all headings and many labels, frequently emphasized by being placed within a hand-drawn yellow highlight box.

A high-contrast primary palette of bright yellow, royal blue, and black/white is used for distinct section backgrounds and text, complemented by a light beige for secondary surfaces and a vibrant purple for calls to action.

The main navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and changing its background from transparent to a solid light beige, while content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
The 'As Seen In' section is presented as a horizontally scrolling ticker at the bottom of the hero, providing social proof in a dynamic, non-intrusive way.

technique_notes: The site uses a smooth scrolling library (locomotive-scroll) to create a fluid, controlled scroll experience, combined with scroll-triggered animations that reveal content sections and transform the sticky navigation bar.
A full-bleed video hero plays on loop, serving as a dynamic background for the initial viewport, with key messaging overlaid in high-contrast typography.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields are designed with a hand-drawn, slightly irregular yellow highlight or outline, giving them a playful, sketched appearance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, often uppercase, labels and standard readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners for blocks and images, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced padding within content blocks, creating a clear visual hierarchy.

standout: The distinctive blend of a vibrant, high-contrast color palette (electric yellow, royal blue, purple) with playful, hand-drawn graphic elements and bold, uppercase typography creates a unique, energetic, and interactive brand identity that perfectly suits a museum focused on engaging visitors.
